controls.name: update-keeps-statistics
controls.find: Mode::Update => stores_written(st, div, hf, e, st.raw.update(choose|i: int| occupied_at(st.raw, e, i), e)),
controls.replace: Mode::Update => St { raw: st.raw.update(choose|i: int| occupied_at(st.raw, e, i), e), ..st },
controls.classification: effect: an update at an occupied coordinate leaves count, sum, bucket and extremes alone (the docstrings' 'original value' reading of bug-tmp-002)

controls.name: insert-overwrites
controls.replace: _ => stores_written(st, div, hf, e, st.raw.update(choose|i: int| occupied_at(st.raw, e, i), e)),
controls.classification: guard: remove WriteStores' collision/skip early return (the pre-spec-254 overwrite)

controls.name: counters-journaled
controls.find: cnt: after.cnt, sum: after.sum, bkt: after.bkt }
controls.replace: cnt: before.cnt, sum: before.sum, bkt: before.bkt }
controls.classification: effect: a rollback also undoes count, sum and bucket (the bug-tmp-003 repair: journaled Sets instead of $Increment)

controls.name: whole-reads-raw
controls.find: if whole(b, lo, hi, div) { stat_agg(st, (g, b, s, p)) }
controls.replace: if whole(b, lo, hi, div) { raw_agg(st.raw, g, s, p, b_lo(b, div), b_hi(b, div)) }
controls.classification: decision: GetAggregate reads a whole bucket edge by edge too (no pre-aggregates)

controls.name: cut-reads-tagg
controls.find: if whole(b, lo, hi, div) { stat_agg(st, (g, b, s, p)) }
controls.replace: if true { stat_agg(st, (g, b, s, p)) }
controls.classification: decision: every touched bucket counted whole (the pre-4.6.0 R217 behavior)

controls.name: none-checked
controls.classification: decision: the store tests the driver's None before converting (the bug-tmp-009 repair; the docstring's 0.0)

controls.name: raw-purge-drops-statistics
controls.find: pub open spec fn purge_raw_before(st: St, g: int, lo: int, hi: int) -> St { St { raw: purge_raw(st.raw, g, lo, hi), ..st } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn purge_raw_before(st: St, g: int, lo: int, hi: int) -> St { St { raw: purge_raw(st.raw, g, lo, hi), cnt: Map::empty(), ..st } }
controls.classification: effect: the raw purge also removes the statistics (legacy PurgeBefore's behavior)

controls.name: delete-skips-missing-statistics
controls.replace: if st.cnt.contains_key(k4(e, div)) { rebuild(st1, div, hf, k4(e, div)) } else { st1 }
controls.classification: guard: a delete rebuilds only statistics that exist (one answer to the q-tmp-002 mirror)

controls.name: bursts-filter-predicate
controls.find: present(st, g, s, (now - window) / div, now / div) && velocity(st, div, g, s, window, now_ts, clock_s) >= threshold
controls.replace: present(st, g, s, (now - window) / div, now / div) && velocity(st, div, g, s, window, now_ts, clock_s) >= threshold && pred == 0
controls.classification: decision: FindBursts reads its predicate argument (F-0508's documented parameter)

controls.name: burst-threshold-strict
controls.find: present(st, g, s, (now - window) / div, now / div) && velocity(st, div, g, s, window, now_ts, clock_s) >= threshold
controls.replace: present(st, g, s, (now - window) / div, now / div) && velocity(st, div, g, s, window, now_ts, clock_s) > threshold
controls.classification: decision: the threshold excludes its own value

controls.name: velocity-not-rounded
controls.find: bkt_sum(st, g, s, (now - window) / div, now / div)
controls.replace: bkt_sum(st, g, s, (now - window) / div + 1, now / div)
controls.classification: decision: velocity skips the bucket holding now - window

controls.name: ms-now-in-ms
controls.find: pub open spec fn now_of(now_ts: int, clock_s: int) -> int { if now_ts > 0 { now_ts } else { clock_s } }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn now_of(now_ts: int, clock_s: int) -> int { if now_ts > 0 { now_ts } else { clock_s * 1000 } }
controls.classification: effect: the default now in the millisecond class's unit

controls.name: small-range-correction
controls.classification: decision: a small-range correction answers 1 for a one-register sketch (the bug-tmp-103 repair direction)

controls.name: no-empty-guard
controls.classification: guard: remove the all-zero sketch guard (the raw estimator answers 11 for nothing)

controls.name: distinct-whole-buckets-only
controls.find: estimate(merged(st, g, s, p, bucket_of(lo, div), bucket_of(hi, div)))
controls.replace: estimate(merged(st, g, s, p, bucket_of(lo + div - 1, div), bucket_of(hi, div)))
controls.classification: decision: the distinct count skips a bucket the window's start cuts

controls.name: escape-values
controls.find: pub open spec fn enc(v: Seq<char>) -> Seq<char> { qt() + v + qt() }
controls.replace: pub open spec fn enc(v: Seq<char>) -> Seq<char> { qt() + esc(v) + qt() }
controls.classification: effect: InternLabelSet escapes string values (the F-0509 / bug-tmp-104 repair)
